Enum Class ComponentType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ComponentType>
org.patternfly.component.ComponentType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ComponentType>, Constable
public enum ComponentType extends Enum<ComponentType>
Enumerates all PatternFly component types with their short ID and OUIA component name.
